text.en: A hole no longer than a finger can threaten a whole village.

Holland has much land below sea level, and great walls called dikes keep the North Sea out. Even little children know that a small hole in a dike is dangerous. In the story a young boy, Peter, finds a leak in the dike and stays there, plugging it, to save his people.
It is a true-style story of a little boy with a brave heart and love for his village. It teaches courage, responsibility and that one person's brave act can save many.
Words to learn: dike, leak, flood, hero and sea level. The story uses simple, clear sentences and builds suspense.
